name: Shortcode
description: Adds a shortcode class extending AbstractShortcode from rtcamp/wp-framework. One class per shortcode tag; the consumer's Shortcodes module instantiates it via the Loader.

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the shortcode class. Default 'Inc\Shortcodes' matches the rtCamp skeleton.
Directory for the shortcode file. Default 'includes/Shortcodes'.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Shortcodes'.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Shortcodes'.
Shortcode tag, lowercase, no spaces, e.g. 'my_plugin_button'.
PascalCase class name, derived from tag.

wiring.description: Add the new shortcode class to the Shortcodes module's get_classes() array. The framework's Loader will instantiate it and call register_hooks() on init. If the Shortcodes module does not exist yet, scaffold it first via `wp-tooling add wp/module --name=Shortcodes --kind=shortcode`.
